CableInfo.isStrandFill.title: isStrandFill
CableInfo.isStrandFill.description: True if wire strands are extruded in a way to fill the voids in the cable.

WireInfo.sizeDescription.title: sizeDescription
WireInfo.sizeDescription.description: Describes the wire gauge or cross section (e.g., 4/0, #2, 336.5).

WireInfo.insulationThickness.title: insulationThickness
WireInfo.insulationThickness.description: (if insulated conductor) Thickness of the insulation.

WireInfo.coreStrandCount.title: coreStrandCount
WireInfo.coreStrandCount.description: (if used) Number of strands in the steel core.

Ravens.cimObjectType.title: cimObjectType
Ravens.cimObjectType.description: Used in RAVENS Schema to identify the corresponding CIM Object Type of the JSON object.

WireInfo.ratedCurrent.title: ratedCurrent
WireInfo.ratedCurrent.description: Current carrying capacity of the wire under stated thermal conditions.

ConcentricNeutralCableInfo.neutralStrand.title: neutralStrandGmr
ConcentricNeutralCableInfo.neutralStrand.description: Geometric mean radius of the neutral strand.

IdentifiedObject.description.title: description
IdentifiedObject.description.description: The description is a free human readable text describing or naming the object. It may be non unique and may not correlate to a naming hierarchy.

ConcentricNeutralCableInfo.diameterOverN.title: diameterOverNeutral
ConcentricNeutralCableInfo.diameterOverN.description: Diameter over the concentric neutral strands.

CableInfo.outerJacketKind.title: outerJacketKind
CableInfo.outerJacketKind.description: Kind of outer jacket of this cable.

WireInfo.rDC20.title: rDC20
WireInfo.rDC20.description: DC resistance per unit length of the conductor at 20 °C.

CableInfo.diameterOverCore.title: diameterOverCore
CableInfo.diameterOverCore.description: Diameter over the core, including any semi-con screen; should be the insulating layer's inside diameter.

WireInfo.rAC50.title: rAC50
WireInfo.rAC50.description: AC resistance per unit length of the conductor at 50 °C.

WireInfo.coreRadius.title: coreRadius
WireInfo.coreRadius.description: (if there is a different core material) Radius of the central core.

WireInfo.insulationMaterial.title: insulationMaterial
WireInfo.insulationMaterial.description: (if insulated conductor) Material used for insulation.

ConcentricNeutralCableInfo.neutralStrand.title: neutralStrandRadius
ConcentricNeutralCableInfo.neutralStrand.description: Outside radius of the neutral strand.

CableInfo.diameterOverJacket.title: diameterOverJacket
CableInfo.diameterOverJacket.description: Diameter over the outermost jacketing layer.

IdentifiedObject.name.title: name
IdentifiedObject.name.description: The name is any free human readable and possibly non unique text naming the object.

CableInfo.sheathAsNeutral.title: sheathAsNeutral
CableInfo.sheathAsNeutral.description: True if sheath / shield is used as a neutral (i.e., bonded).

WireInfo.rAC75.title: rAC75
WireInfo.rAC75.description: AC resistance per unit length of the conductor at 75 °C.

WireInfo.strandCount.title: strandCount
WireInfo.strandCount.description: Number of strands in the conductor.

ConcentricNeutralCableInfo.neutralStrand.title: neutralStrandRDC20
ConcentricNeutralCableInfo.neutralStrand.description: DC resistance per unit length of the neutral strand at 20 °C.

CableInfo.diameterOverInsulation.title: diameterOverInsulation
CableInfo.diameterOverInsulation.description: Diameter over the insulating layer, excluding outer screen.

CableInfo.constructionKind.title: constructionKind
CableInfo.constructionKind.description: Kind of construction of this cable.

WireInfo.rAC25.title: rAC25
WireInfo.rAC25.description: AC resistance per unit length of the conductor at 25 °C.

CableInfo.diameterOverScreen.title: diameterOverScreen
CableInfo.diameterOverScreen.description: Diameter over the outer screen; should be the shield's inside diameter.

WireInfo.gmr.title: gmr
WireInfo.gmr.description: Geometric mean radius. If we replace the conductor by a thin walled tube of radius GMR, then its reactance is identical to the reactance of the actual conductor.

IdentifiedObject.aliasName.title: aliasName
IdentifiedObject.aliasName.description:
The aliasName is free text human readable name of the object alternative to IdentifiedObject.name. It may be non unique and may not correlate to a naming hierarchy.
The attribute aliasName is retained because of backwards compatibility between CIM relases. It is however recommended to replace aliasName with the Name class as aliasName is planned for retirement at a future time.

IdentifiedObject.mRID.title: mRID
IdentifiedObject.mRID.description:
Master resource identifier issued by a model authority. The mRID is unique within an exchange context. Global uniqueness is easily achieved by using a UUID, as specified in RFC 4122, for the mRID. The use of UUID is strongly recommended.
For CIMXML data files in RDF syntax conforming to IEC 61970-552, the mRID is mapped to rdf:ID or rdf:about attributes that identify CIM object elements.
